understanding.goal_understanding: The goal is to complete each KA59 level by moving every selectable piece onto the goal tiles marked with a '+'. If there are multiple goal tiles, all of them must be occupied at the same time to trigger WIN before the level's step budget runs out, and then continue through all levels until the full run reports WIN.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Actions were issued by CLICKing a target grid coordinate. A CLICK attempts to move the currently selected piece toward/onto the clicked tile, typically in a straight line until it reaches the destination or is stopped. If the path is blocked by walls/obstacles or a movement rule prevents that move, the piece does not change position and the click consumes a step. Clicking another reachable tile can move the selected piece there; pieces cannot pass through blocking tiles. Selection seems to remain on the same piece across clicks (there was no explicit separate select action in the log), and movement only occurred when the clicked position was reachable; otherwise it resulted in 'blocked or action has no movement effect'.
